scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @gethired/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @gethired/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace @gethired/contracts && npm run build --workspace @gethired/api
scripts.test:interviews:postgres: npm run build --workspace @gethired/contracts && node --import tsx tests/interview-postgres-audit.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @gethired/contracts && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @gethired/api
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @gethired/contracts && npm run test --workspace @gethired/api && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
